nodes.assertion: Natural new-project selection creates the neutral scaffold, forwards the original literal request once, retains routing response/usage and reserves 9 product calls plus 1 routing call.
Modify dispatch selects the configured source; defer-approval remains and source-disclosure permission is not invented.
Changing the execution profile during model selection produces TASK_INTENT_CONTEXT_CHANGED before product allocation.
Resume invokes the selected existing owner once with the original allocation config and never prepares another task or silently resets budget.
The normal CLI forwards stdin, active run and routing options exactly and reports needs_clarification without adding authority.
Clarification dispatch retains original and corrected requirements, counts both routing calls and replays an identical answer without a second product dispatch.
A clarification receipt from another conversation is rejected with NOT_IN_CONVERSATION.
reference_only plus modify_project does not dispatch; the question identifies the actual project without claiming the user named multiple projects, and native decision provenance is retained.
Explicit target confirmation returns through the normal owner once, retains the earlier receipt bytes and complete conversation, and replay remains idempotent.
A follow-up model still labeling the selected project reference_only cannot bypass the role gate even after a confirming user answer.
Actual rg and source read return the expected path, hash and excerpt while lexical evidence alone remains insufficient and cannot authorize a patch.
Live excerpts preserve CRLF bytes and remain an exact byte subsequence of the source preimage.
A single explicit Plugin.cs request selects its Load method instead of more tempting matches in another source file.
Two live Plugin.cs files are rejected as an ambiguous exact filename with resolved_count=2 rather than arbitrarily selecting one.
A parent-directory search root returns no evidence, remains insufficient and carries an explicit workspace-escape blocker before rg dispatch.
Two requirement queries retain all three collaborating source materials for Findings, using the four-item material floor and 32768-byte cap without granting semantic coverage.
An item-budget omission records the omitted source path, hash, reason and source_read=true while explicitly keeping omitted IDs non-citeable.
A too-large material is omitted with an explicit byte-limit reason and a later small material still fits; retained excerpts remain complete.
The actual Findings input receives omission facts but its source observations and citation enum contain only retained evidence IDs.
A genuine rg lexical miss can supply bounded current source separately; a lexical hit uses the normal lane and preserves the same source identity.
Production Planning uses exactly the scripted model-selected evidence IDs as edit bindings, retains response/usage/traces and forwards semantic feedback to Patch boundaries.
The runnable installed by build_graph invokes the configured model selector once and writes a successful implementation plan.
Planning can select an allowed source outside Findings target hints, and the resulting edit registry follows that selected evidence ID.
A model-selected auxiliary source outside the prepared authoritative enum is rejected and its blocked receipt is retained.
Source identity sharing round-trips the complete Planning input, including repeated observations, features, semantic feedback and allowed edit IDs without mutating inputs.
Source drift before selection produces a blocked plan and receipt with zero model calls.
Source drift during selection produces a blocked plan and receipt while retaining the one actual scripted model response.
Compiler-candidate planning uses exactly the bounded scope and preserves verification questions without rewriting the original insufficient Findings into semantic success.
Selecting a genuinely observed source outside compiler-candidate scope blocks the plan and leaves proposed_changes empty.
Explicit custom API/source evidence requirements survive template-policy filtering and remain required before Patch.
Patch source inspection rejects a path escaping the workspace and a preimage hash inconsistent with the bound plan.
The scripted worker performs one legal binding read then a final turn, preserving correlated tool result, two-turn usage, admitted observation hash and terminal reason.
Leading prose plus JSON is rejected as malformed structured output without extracting a permissive payload or echoing implementation code.
A scripted failing candidate receives one correction and a second bound evaluation before proposal creation; both reports persist and original source bytes remain unchanged.
Source drift during candidate evaluation stops before correction and before any proposal, review or dry-run artifact.
A valid persisted report hash cannot authorize a returned dictionary changed from failure to pass; the behavior evaluation is rejected before proposal.
Evaluator OSError retains the initial model response, stops before proposal and does not spend an additional correction call.
A recorded feedback counterexample reproduces 36339 old combined bytes and projects to 28633 under the unchanged 30472-byte allowance; this is offline representation verification.
Public expected/observed projection preserves input, error arrays and boolean-versus-integer differences and reconstructs the original assertion exactly.
Repeated observation values compress while every check, input, ordered result and typed value round-trips exactly and original feedback remains unchanged.
Recovery admission counts exactly the UTF-8 bytes of the projected correction messages that are sent, and the visible observations restore to the original feedback.
Cyclic or tampered observation reference tables fail restoration instead of silently changing verifier facts.
Second identical submission reports unchanged_skip, adds no embedding calls, and keeps exact vector/BM25 IDs.
